sourceClaims.claim: Document specimens establish 55px body, 38px file visual, 12px radius and default/hover/error paint
width is container-driven rather than a public specimen-width enum
the filename and independent native actions own activation; the row root is inert

evidence.source-integrity: pass: Documents.svg is traced directly for geometry and paint rather than relying on prior source tests
evidence.structural-contract: pass: all seven roots are classified and keep visual, content and trailing actions as siblings
evidence.runtime-browser: not-applicable: File Row has no controller or root activation; native links and buttons own their behavior
evidence.accessibility: pass: root stays inert, decorative file visuals are hidden and filename/action targets retain meaningful native names
evidence.focused-visual: pass: computed body/icon/action geometry, truncation and real hover paint are asserted
evidence.consumer-integration: not-applicable: no real application consumer exists in this repository; executable and stress fixtures are not relabeled as consumers
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: long and extensionless names truncate while the fixed visual and trailing action area remain contained

staticVisual: pass: forced hover and error fixtures are retained only as static source comparisons
realInteractionVisual: pass: locator.hover() on a linked File Row produces the source-backed background paint
runtimeBehavior: not-applicable: File Row delegates navigation and actions to nested native Link/Button elements

interactionEvidence.manualStateWalk: pass: row hover, filename Tab focus, action focus, long/no-extension names and narrow containment inspected

knownLimitations: upload progress, preview and whole-row activation are not public File Row behavior
